description: Declared NSW public holidays under the Public Holidays Act 2010 (NSW), as published by the NSW Government.

evidence.method: Scraped from the official NSW Government public-holidays page on the checked date; page last modified 2026-07-16.

caveats: Local public holidays and local event days declared for particular NSW local government areas are not included; confirm registry-location holidays before relying on a business-day computation.
The NSW Bank Holiday (first Monday in August) is not a declared public holiday and is excluded.
The published table lists an Additional Day after Anzac Day (Monday 27 April 2026; Monday 26 April 2027); it is included exactly as published.
